An ancient ring found entombed in Ancient City chests and hidden tavern cellars. Dormant upon discovery, it hums with a hunger for hostile souls.

§6Soul Siphoning Attunement§r
Equip in a Ring curio slot to begin attunement. Every second, the ring siphons essence from nearby hostile monsters within 5 blocks, dealing minor magic damage. Siphoning 1,000 hostile souls awakens its protective ward.

§6The Tombstone Ward§r
If you fall in battle while wearing the attuned ring:
• An indestructible §5Tombstone§r is placed at your death site, holding all your items, armor, offhand gear, and Curios trinkets.
• §6100% of your accumulated experience points§r are preserved without penalty.
• An §cEternal Guardian§r is summoned to stand watch, attacking any players or monsters who approach.

Right-click the tombstone to instantly restore your gear to its original slots and retrieve your XP. The guardian dismisses peacefully once your belongings are recovered.
